edits.why: version pin moved to the latest pandas

edits.old: Setting `error_bad_lines` to False skips the rows that have too many fields.
edits.new: Setting `on_bad_lines` to `skip` drops the rows that have too many fields.

edits.old: `iteritems` yields each column name with its values.
edits.new: `items` yields each column name with its values.

edits.old: In pandas 1.4.4, `Float64Index` is the type for float labels.
edits.new: In pandas 2.0 and later, a plain `Index` holds float labels, since `Float64Index` was removed.
`mean` needs `numeric_only=True` to skip the text column.
edits.why: the text column is no longer dropped silently

edits.old: `line_terminator` sets the line ending that `to_csv` writes.
edits.new: `lineterminator` sets the line ending that `to_csv` writes.
edits.why: to_csv line_terminator was renamed to lineterminator and then removed
